authors: K. Moore, A. Duspayev, R. Cardman, G. Raithel
title: Measurement of the Rb g-series quantum defect using two-photon microwave spectroscopy
method: two-photon microwave spectroscopy of cold 85Rb in a MOT, ng prepared by three-photon excitation with electric-field mixing, 40 us pulses, 3D stray-field cancellation
uncertainty: per-interval total uncertainties 4.6-14 kHz (Table I contributions)
conversion: No J in the source from l = 4 on (fine structure unresolved): j = l + 1/2 assumed (the fine structure of these levels is far below the uncertainties).

The data are 85Rb, rydstate's Rb has the atomic mass 86.909180529 u: intervals are multiplied by the ratio of the reduced masses mu(Rb) / mu(85Rb) = 1.000000148480 (the quantum defects are the same); energies from the ground state are not scaled, they need a free offset in the fit (their binding energies differ by the same relative amount, less than 1 MHz for n >= 20).
caveats: Method A and B rows are correlated: use one of them in a fit
